title: Follow the rules for door-to-door and phone selling
what: When selling to consumers at their door or by phone without being asked, keep to the permitted hours and the disclosure, agreement and cooling-off rules.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.locator: Schedule 2 (Australian Consumer Law), s 73(1) (compilation C2026C00405, in force from 2026-09-16)
sources.quote: A dealer must not call on a person for the purpose of negotiating an unsolicited consumer agreement, or for an incidental or related purpose: (a) at any time on a Sunday or a public holiday; or (b) before 9 am on any other day; or (c) after 6 pm on any other day (or after 5 pm if the other day is a Saturday).

reach.note: Calibration: coded for the calibration classes; other classes that sell door to door follow in phase C.
